thread:
nate: Heads-up: new hire ran the sampleapp and got tripped by env var names. README says REDWOOD_API_KEY, CLI docs use REDWOOD_KEY, docker uses REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY.

tara: ouch. Which one wins in practice?

nate: CLI resolver currently prefers org-scoped keys over project-scoped ones. So if both are set the app authenticates as the org. That broke a demo.

leo: repro steps: `export REDWOOD_PROJECT_API_KEY=proj_x; export REDWOOD_ORG_KEY=org_y; ./start.sh` -> app calls under org_y. Should prefer project.

tara: agreed. We intended resolver order: CLI arg > project env > org env > kube secret. The code has a bug.

nate: also noticed rotation is noisy: when project keys rotate the CLI silently falls back to org key and streams drop. New PM thought the product was flaky.

leo: small fixes: 1) standardize README and examples to REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_API_KEY. 2) change CLI resolver to prefer project env. 3) emit a warning in logs when scope switches due to fallback.

tara: I'll file a tiny unit test in sampleapp CI to ensure project env beats org env.

ci-bot: created issue #512: sampleapp - env var resolver prefers project over org requested by tara.

nate: thanks. low-risk/ high-impact. I'll update onboarding playbook once PR merges.
